rationale: The assistant led with the correct simple checks (unplug, roller ring, coupler, plate seating) and, once the customer reported the cracked three-pronged coupler with a rounded hole and a moving metal shaft, correctly concluded a stripped turntable coupler with the motor still working, matching the hidden truth. Safety handling was sound ('Do not open the microwave casing', unplugged inspection only) and the motor fallback was appropriately hedged. The main gap is that it never asked for the model number (Sharp R272WM) needed to source the correct clip-on coupler, so the homeowner is left without a concrete route to the part, although no compatibility claim was made.
